summary: The Pentagon is making a formal push to access private UFO archives, according to journalist Ross Coulthart, raising questions about what records exist outside government channels and why officials suddenly want them now. Meanwhile, a congressional staffer reportedly told Coulthart that classified briefings have detailed recovered crafts and recovered beings, adding weight to longstanding claims about retrieval programs. On the international front, Poland scrambled aircraft over a suspected airspace breach while British MPs continued pressing their government over Five Eyes UFO cooperation, suggesting these aren't purely American concerns. New archived documents spanning from February through October 2024 have been added to public collections, though details remain sparse. The week also saw celebrity attention shift the conversation when Sandra Bullock disclosed her own sighting on podcast, while physicists explored potential links between warp drive physics and recent Pentagon-documented phenomena.
